body:
On the "widespread suffering" question:'

Manifesto, para. 2
"the industrial tech. system may survive...if it survives it may achieve
a low level of physical & psch. suffering, but only at the cost
of...permanently reducing human beings to engineered products & mere
cogs in the social machine. 
3. If the system breaks down the consequences will still be very
painful. But the bigger the system gros the more disastrous the results
of its breakdown wil be, so if it is to break down it had best break
down sooner than later.

Or do y'all think it would be OK to live a happy life as a race of
homogenized, controlled, genetically engineered Gammas & Betas who are
fed our Soma every day?

headers.Subject: Re: Kaczynski on the widespread suffering that will result
